background.value: Plain, uniform, light grey or cream (5-10% grey recommended). Accessible standards also list: different shades of white (cream, ivory, vanilla) and light grey. Pure white not recommended due to biometric edge detection issues

head_height.value: 29-34mm from bottom of chin to crown of head

validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last month (1 month). Exception: up to 12 months for adults and 6 months for children in delayed applications

file_spec.value: Digital: at least 600x750 pixels, 50KB-10MB, color only (no black and white). Printed: plain white photographic paper, no border, high quality medium/low gloss or matt

clothing_restriction.value: Bare shoulders and uniforms acceptable. Reject clothing hiding facial features (high scarves covering chin). Hoods/coat collars acceptable if facial features visible

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression (neither frowning nor smiling), mouth closed. Relaxed mouth with slightly visible teeth acceptable. Reject if expression distorts facial shape (wide smile, pouting, frowning). Children under 6 exempt

glasses_policy.value: Remove glasses to ensure accurate biometric. Dark, tinted, or mirrored glasses must be removed. If worn: both eyes must be clearly visible (white and pupil), frames may cover eye socket/eyelids but not eyes, no glare/reflection covering eyes

ears_visibility.value: No earphones, ear buds, or over-head headphones. Visible hearing aids acceptable. Edges of face must show clearly

face_visibility.value: Full front view of face and shoulders, squared to camera, centered. Chin and top of head clearly visible. Nothing covering the face. Eyes in top 40-70% of photo (vertical eye band). No tilting

headwear_policy.value: Not permitted except for religious headwear (if not covering face) or medical head coverings (scarves, bandages for wounds/hair loss). Hair accessories acceptable if facial features clear

accessories.value: No earphones/headphones. Hearing aids acceptable. Beards and moustaches acceptable. Single-colored bindi acceptable. Permanent tattoos acceptable. Temporary jewelry bindis rejected. Multiple piercings rejected if causing reflection

is_white_background_allowed.value: Partially - off-white shades (cream, ivory, vanilla) are explicitly allowed per accessible standards. Pure white is not recommended; photographer guide specifies 5-10% grey. Automated biometric edge detection may have difficulty with pure white against pale skin
